newsitem.title: USA: First Union says Santander sells shares.
newsitem.headline: First Union says Santander sells shares.

text.p: First Union Corp said on Tuesday it was informed by Spain's Banco Santander that Banco Santander sold 5.214 million post-split shares of First Union common stock.
This would cut Banco's First Union stake to 7.12 percent from 7.96 percent on a pro forma basis, First Union said.

First Union said it was told by Banco Santander that capital gains from the sale would increase Banco Santander's book net worth. Another factor in the decision was the dollar's strength against the peseta, it said.

"Banco Santander does not currently plan to sell any additional shares of First Union stock, and we remain a satisfied, long-term investor in the company," First Union quoted the Spanish bank as saying.
